verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a local API, CLI/headless mode, MCP server, and an Agents skill that let AI assistants read, search, modify, and script against Objects and chats, covering much of the core UI functionality (objects, types, queries, chats). However, there's no evidence the API surface covers everything the UI offers — e.g., web publishing, template/gallery management, widgets/sidebar customization, or membership/ANY ID settings — and no OpenAPI spec was discoverable (404s on probe), suggesting an incomplete or undocumented API surface relative to the UI. missing for 10: confirmed API parity for publishing, templates, widgets/sidebar config, membership settings, and a discoverable full API reference/OpenAPI spec.
